decision: Where do Maya, the controls and the words go while a call is on: does the desk stay, does the board take the whole screen, or does Maya sit beside the board?
primary_axis: how much of the call screen belongs to the board
invariants: Same question (page 23, number 4: 27 + 39), same child, same Maya lines
Same tokens and desk CSS (vendor/desk.css is a copy of src/components/desk.css)

Board drawn with the real Relief SingleLine glyphs and the real board colours; layout placed by hand

references.use: Desk stays in the call: rail, Maya column with transcript, tabs, call pill on the board, caption, pen bar. D-184 makes this the base.
Board-only view with the same pill.

options.name: The desk goes live
options.bet: The call is the same desk the child already knows, and it matches the home-page video.
options.benefit: Nothing moves when a call starts. The transcript helps a child who missed a word. Same place as chat.
options.cost: The rail and column take 500 px of the board's width on a laptop (canvas 858 px; B has 1358 px). At 1024 x 768 the canvas is 455 px wide. At 768 x 1024 it is 280 px.
options.risk: More things on screen for a young child; the tabs can be tapped during a call.

options.name: The board is the room
options.bet: A child in a call should look at the math and nothing else.
options.benefit: Largest digits at every width (canvas 1358 px on a laptop, 955 px and 711 px on a tablet). One layout everywhere. Matches the board-only video.
options.cost: No transcript, only the last line. No tabs, so no Call-only view in the call. The desk disappears when a call starts.
options.risk: A child who missed a sentence cannot read back. On a laptop the screen is very empty around the sum.

options.name: Maya beside the board
options.bet: A large, warm Maya makes the call feel like talking with someone.
options.benefit: The clearest talking and listening state. Hang up has a label. Follows spec #297 and the FigJam board.
options.cost: The 340 px column takes the board down to 1006 px on a laptop and 603 px at 1024 x 768. It sits on the opposite side from the desk's column, so Maya moves when a call starts. It repeats words shown on the board.
options.risk: The large picture may suggest a real person more than a small one does; it draws the eye away from the math.

recommendation.pick: Mix: A at 1024 px and wider, B below 1024 px
why: D-184 made the video's desk the base, and Savar rejected r301 because it did not look like his design.
At 1024 x 768 A leaves a canvas 455 px wide and 502 px high, which holds the sum and the side work.
At 768 x 1024 A leaves only 280 px, and the side work gets small; B gives 711 px at the same size.
On a phone the board must fill the screen (spec story 23), so A and B are nearly the same there (canvas 356 px wide in both).
recommendation.what_c_gives: Take C's labelled hang up idea only if testing shows children miss the icon. The mix keeps the icon, as in the video.

recommended_more.pattern: A at laptop and tablet-l, B at tablet-p and phone: shots/opt-<a|b>-<state>-<viewport>.png

rules_used.minutes: 30 min a week, Monday in family time; a call up to 10 min, or what is left; under 1 min no call starts; closing at 9 min or the last minute. Left rounds down (usageMinutes). Reconnect gaps do not count (docs/maya-voice.md).
rules_used.try_maya: 2 min per parent per local day (DEMO_DAILY_MINUTES). No child minutes, no learning events.
rules_used.reconnect: Maya waits 30 s for the child, then the call ends as a technical issue (docs/maya-voice.md).
rules_used.join: The admin call waits 45 s for Maya (MAYA_JOIN_MS).

for_the_build: Check the microphone before the call row and the minutes grant exist, so 'No minutes were used.' is true after a refusal. A call row holds its whole grant until it ends.

Mic steps are from Apple and Google help pages (Safari: page menu, Website Settings, Microphone; Chrome: icon beside the address, Microphone). Check each on a real device before release: the labels change between versions. A later Safari may not show aA.
'Chat with Maya instead' shows only when chat is open for that child (D-241: Grade 3 and up, on the list).
The call's 'Say page and number' uses the reference room of #335, so the mic question comes before the call there.
While the child holds the pen, Maya's staged drawing is cancelled (R450-10); the board note 'Maya has the pen' from src/components/our-board.tsx stays for a stroke without the pen.
In option A, Leave stays in the rail during a call and the PIN dialog says it ends the call (pin-call). In B there is no rail, so Leave is one hang up away.
The call screen must not say audio is not kept: docs/maya-voice.md says provider settings are not verified yet. The privacy page holds that text (#529, PR #596).
The parent notice of PR #596 comes before the first call: 'Open the desk' goes to it first and the call token is refused without it. It is not redrawn here.
Reduced motion: the board shows finished strokes, the waves and rings stop. State always has words.

words_needing_a_line.text: We have one minute left. Let's finish this question.
words_needing_a_line.why: lines.ts has no line that tells the child time is short. TIME_CLOSE goes straight to give_answer, ask_write, close. New code-written bank line; Savar approves wording.
Try Maya has no page and number, so WORKBOOK_OPENING does not fit.

open_decisions.question: Which call layout?
open_decisions.recommend: A at 1024 px and wider, B below.

open_decisions.question: D-183 keeps a Call tab without the board; spec #297 says the board is always there. Keep Call as a view during a call?
open_decisions.recommend: Keep it on tablet and laptop, as a view of the same call (call-only). A child can look at the paper and Maya keeps drawing. No tabs on a phone.

open_decisions.question: D-240 has Maya say she cannot help during a call. Check before the call instead?
open_decisions.recommend: Yes (held). It uses no minutes and no mic. D-239 counted 0 of 204 questions teachable in U4 and 43 of 231 in U16 on 2026-11-04, so until #525 and #526 land, most questions a child picks would reach this screen.

open_decisions.question: Calls stop when a plan is not free trial or active. Should a failed payment stop calls at once, while the card company retries?
open_decisions.recommend: Follow the rule for the first customer (desk-off, p-failed). Consider some days of grace later: a child loses Maya because of a card.

open_decisions.question: Approve the new Maya lines listed in words_needing_a_line.
open_decisions.recommend: Approve or rewrite; none is said until code has it.
